title: Apply for a licence to process or store plant products
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a licence from the NSW Food Authority if your business processes or stores plant products.
intro:
You must hold a licence with the NSW Food Authority if your business prepares or stores:

You can apply and pay for the licence online.

To apply for 5 or more premises, you need to complete a printed application form.

Note: You must not start business operations until you have your licence.
who_can_apply: Your business prepares or stores plant products.
what_you_need: ASIC company statement showing the director names (if applicable)
Confirmation of your registered business name (if applicable)
Details of the business activities, location and food handlers

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Application for a licence for a premises to process/store plant products – PDF.
Submit your application with payment by post or email, to the details on the form.

more_info.text: To change or cancel a licence, contact the Food Authority Licensing Unit on (02) 6552 3000.
If you transport plant products, you need to apply for a licence to operate a food business.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to process or store plant products?
faqs.a: Yes, you must hold a licence with the NSW Food Authority if your business prepares or stores plant products.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You can apply and pay for the licence online. If you are applying for 5 or more premises, you must complete a printed application form.

faqs.q: When can I start my business?
faqs.a: You must not start business operations until you have received your licence.
